I design and deliver scalable, production-grade web applications across FinTech, SaaS, E-commerce, Transportation, and Real Estate. With a Bachelor's degree in IT and 15+ years in the industry, I specialize in building modular, API-first systems with clean, maintainable architecture.

I've led cross-functional teams of 4–6 developers, managing architecture, task estimation, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and task distribution. I ensure code quality through reviews, guide technical decision-making, and keep delivery aligned with business priorities across the full agile cycle.

Certified by IBM, Edchart, and LaraDaily, I apply SOLID principles, PSR standards, CI/CD pipelines, and test-driven development to produce reliable, observable, and extensible code for both greenfield builds and legacy system refactors.
